# Documentation

Current-state documentation for `casa-specialist-finance` — the casa household finance
specialist: a role, a persona, and two bundled plugins, one of which is a standard-library
MCP server over PSD2 bank account information.

> Code is the source of truth. This file is a map; when it and the code disagree, the code wins.

Start with the row that matches what you are about to change.

`llms.txt` is the same corpus as a flat list, and `doctrine/invariants.md` collects every
`INV-` id with the file that defines it. Both are generated; so is the table above.

New here? Read `architecture/overview.md` first — it says which document owns what.
Changing the documentation itself? `contributing/doc-contract.md` is the contract, and
`doctrine/publishing.md` is the rule everything else follows from.
